automations.name: Enquiry → Gmail draft
automations.trigger: A visitor submits the site form
automations.action: Summarise the enquiry and create a Gmail draft reply with the next step.
automations.guard: Draft only. You read it, edit it, and press send.

automations.name: Booking reminders
automations.action: Create a reminder draft with time, service and reschedule link.
automations.guard: Draft only; the client never receives an unapproved message.

automations.name: Lead triage
automations.action: Score fit, tag the request, and write the record into the data board.
automations.guard: No record is deleted; every change is logged.

automations.name: Follow-up sequence
automations.action: Prepare three short follow-up drafts with the original context attached.
automations.guard: You approve each draft. The sequence stops the moment the client replies.

automations.name: Weekly operator report
automations.action: Summarise enquiries, bookings, failed checks and open follow-ups into one message.

automations.name: Live delivery check
automations.action: Fetch the live site and every asset, then record HTTP status and response time.
automations.guard: Read-only. Alerts on failure; never changes the site.

automations.name: Data snapshot
automations.action: Export the current board to a dated CSV so nothing lives in one place.
automations.guard: Local file only. No third-party upload.
